basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I've been diving into the world of ARK: Survival Evolved and Mount & Blade lately, enjoying the strategy and survival elements these games offer. During the day, I work as a software developer, which keeps me busy but also allows me to explore my passion for technology. I'm a night owl, so you'll often find me online during late hours. I enjoy discussions about game mechanics and always appreciate a good tip or trick. In a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my love for gaming and tech.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, I've spent the last decade working in various tech companies, specializing in software development and game design. My interest in gaming started early, and I've self-taught myself a lot about game mechanics and modding through online communities and tutorials.
